label: Бросить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for бросить (to throw, quit, abandon).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. 'Брошу' is the simple future of perfective бросить, with the с → ш mutation of the first person. It marks one completed throw.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Бросишь' keeps the -ишь ending with no mutation, since с → ш appears only in the first person. Here бросить means to quit a habit.

missions.phrase: Он бросит курить в этом году.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Бросит' is the simple future of бросить, here governing the infinitive 'курить' to mean give up. The imperfective partner бросать marks repeated action.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Бросим' takes the -им ending and promises a single completed toss. 'В фонтан' uses в with the accusative for direction.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Бросите' is the respectful -ите future form. 'Якорь' is the accusative object of one decisive action.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Бросил' is the masculine -л past, marking a finished throw. 'В реку' shows direction with в plus accusative.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Бросила' adds the feminine -ла ending. Here бросить means to quit; 'прошлым летом' is an instrumental time phrase.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Бросили' is the plural -ли past for all genders. 'Через забор' uses через with the accusative for the path of the throw.
Strategic focus: Perfective infinitive. 'Бросить' stays infinitive after the impersonal 'пора'. The perfective marks one act of throwing away; imperfective бросать would mark repeated discarding.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Брось' is the informal command of бросить, asking for one quick toss. It contrasts with imperfective бросай for repeated throwing.
